title: For every right map, conditional expectation Omega(s^6)
statement: For s=2^h>=8, every complete globally injected right-line map g satisfies E_f[I_L^(BA,int)(f,g)|g]>=3*s^6/65536 for one uniformly drawn complete globally injected left-point map f. Therefore min_g max_f I_L^(BA,int)(f,g)>=3*s^6/65536, NOT min_(f,g).

quantifiers.domain: arbitrary fixed complete globally injected original line map
one uniformly sampled complete globally injected original point map, with fixed g

external_dependencies: AA4-I genuine original source-line spectral disjoint-pair lower and AA4-N occupied K_a cycle completion proof.
limitations: Does not imply universal seven-class S_s(f,g)>=c*s^6.
No Branch A proof nor full risk exponent.
falsification_boundary: High average f for every g permits exceptional f with low charge; g cannot be changed separately for each original Q.
